svg.title: 6 LEDs · capacity study
svg.desc: Uno D13/D12/D11/D10/D9/D8 each connects through its own 220 ohm resistor and red LED to shared GND1. Breadboard insertion locations and LED polarity are labeled.

g.text: Uno R3 · 6 × 220Ω + LED · fixed 300-hole breadboard · crossings are insulated wires
GND / GND1 = socket between AREF and D13
The physical socket stays fixed when the signal pin changes.
Same physical board: 30 rows, two isolated five-hole banks.
Wire crossings have no electrical junction. Follow the labeled endpoints.
LED numbers match the insertion guide; every resistor is 220Ω.
This pattern fits at most six branches. Ten is rejected before rendering.
13 verified nets · 12 jumper wires · 13 components + one breadboard
Connection-only input · deterministic placement · physical netlist independently verified
Board geometry: Arduino UNO R3 (A000066), adapted. Illustrations: CC BY-SA 4.0 · Bread PoC 0.1
